title: Auto-redirect page hangs on phones because WP Rocket delays the redirect script
symptoms: Page sits on its 'Redirecting...' message for 13 to 15 seconds or forever
Adding ?nocache= to the URL makes it redirect at once
cause: Delay JavaScript Execution holds inline scripts until the visitor interacts. Its release events include mousemove, which touch devices never fire, so desktops self-rescue on any mouse twitch and phones on a page with nothing to tap wait indefinitely.
fix: Exclude the script from delay with a marker string, and render a visible fallback link.
apply: add_filter('rocket_delay_js_exclusions', function ($ex) { $ex[] = 'my-redirect-marker'; return $ex; }); then put /* my-redirect-marker */ inside the inline script
affected: WP Rocket with Delay JavaScript Execution on, September 2026
